lessons: The coupon's actual Alt/Under record was much better documented than the project files suggested.
Over selections were often driven by favorite quality or expected attacking pressure; that did not guarantee three goals.
Under selections failed in matches with early home control or late penalties/late goals.
The Nesine coupon event list is not identical to the official Spor Toto 1-15 list: it contains Cadiz-Celta Vigo B and Samsunspor-Goztepe, so the two lists must remain separate.
Future Alt/Under records must preserve the exact Nesine event order, odds, source URL, timestamp, prediction, and final status.
